topic: When AI Costs More Than the Engineer
headline: AI vs. Engineer Costs
caption:
Today’s story on Hacker News got me thinking - when does AI become too expensive compared to human expertise? As a full stack engineer, I see AI as a powerful tool, but not always cost-effective. Large models and ongoing training can rack up costs quickly, especially for smaller projects. Sometimes, investing in skilled engineers costs less in the long run and offers more flexibility. It’s a reminder that AI isn’t always the cheapest solution - sometimes, experience and creativity win. Stay smart about when to deploy AI and when to lean on human talent! 🚀
